name: prepare_repo
description: Legacy repository preparation. With inPlace:true, create/switch to a run-specific branch before committing every Git-visible existing change as its baseline. Input: repoPath, inPlace?, branch?, branchRunId?, workflowId?.

repoPath.description: Path to the git repository to prepare.

inPlace.description: If true, require repoPath to already be an existing checkout on a named branch, switch to a new run-owned branch, and commit every Git-visible change as its baseline (via git.prepare_inplace). If false, idempotently git-init/set identity/create an initial commit as needed (via git.ensure_ready).

branch.description: Requested outcome branch name for the inPlace path; a run-suffix is appended and collisions are disambiguated.

branchRunId.description: Stable execution ID used to derive the run-specific branch/baseline marker for the inPlace path. Falls back to workflowId, then the task's workflow instance ID.

workflowId.description: Fallback run ID used when branchRunId is not supplied (inPlace path only).

identityName.description: Local git user.name to set if the repo has none configured (non-inPlace path only).

identityEmail.description: Local git user.email to set if the repo has none configured (non-inPlace path only).

repoPath.description: Resolved absolute path (git toplevel) of the prepared repository.

branch.description: Current branch after preparation: the new outcome branch (inPlace) or the repo's existing branch (non-inPlace).

initialized.description: Non-inPlace only: true if `git init` was run because the directory was not yet a repo.

initialCommitCreated.description: Non-inPlace only: true if an initial commit was created because the repo had no HEAD.

head.description: Non-inPlace only: HEAD commit SHA after preparation.

originalBranch.description: InPlace only: the branch the checkout was on before switching to the new outcome branch.

originalHead.description: InPlace only: HEAD commit SHA before the baseline commit was created.

checkpointCommit.description: InPlace only: the baseline commit SHA (same as baselineCommit).

baselineCommit.description: InPlace only: the baseline commit SHA capturing every Git-visible change.

baselineCreated.description: InPlace only: false when a prior baseline for this run was found and reused instead of creating a new one.

marker.description: InPlace only: the local commit-message marker identifying this run's baseline.

statusFingerprintBefore.description: InPlace only: hash of the checkout's working-tree status before the baseline commit.

statusFingerprintAfter.description: InPlace only: hash of the checkout's working-tree status after the baseline commit.

includedPaths.description: InPlace only: paths staged into the baseline commit.

resumed.description: InPlace only: true if an existing baseline for this run was reused rather than created.
